concepts.name: Lowest HBM rating of a QFN-48 pin in V
justifications: The datasheet correction rates QFN-48 pins PB12–PB15 at 1000 V HBM, while all other pins are rated at 2000 V.

concepts.name: Revision C BOR level 2 minimum falling threshold in V
justifications: The product change notification specifically changes the revision C BOR level 2 minimum falling threshold to 2.21 V.

concepts.name: VOS0 permitted at a VDD of 1.8 V
justifications: VOS0 requires VDD to be at least 1.95 V, so it cannot be used at 1.8 V.

concepts.name: Marking code of revision C
justifications: The device identification table gives Y as the marking revision code for production silicon revision C.

concepts.name: DR-115 junction temperature in °C
justifications: At 432 MHz, maximum IDD including the clocked peripherals is 156 + 4.6 + 0.9 + 0.6 + 0.4 = 162.5 mA, and maximum VDD is 3.366 V. Using the soldered QFN-48 thermal resistance of 52 °C/W gives Tj = 70 + 52 × (3.366 × 0.1625 + 0.038) = 100.42 °C, rounded to 100 °C.

concepts.name: Start of the first revision C date code
justifications: Revision C shipments start with date code 2634, meaning ISO week 34 of 2026, whose Monday is 17 August 2026.

concepts.context: aspect: Device limitations of revision C
concepts.name: ES-09 present in revision C
justifications: ES-09 is explicitly present in revisions B and C; production testing confirmed the drift in revision C despite earlier documents listing it as fixed.

concepts.name: ES-08 workaround
predicted: rewrite fdcan_tdcr after each bus-off recovery, before init is cleared.
gold: write fdcan_tdcr again after each bus-off recovery, before init is cleared.
values: Rewrite FDCAN_TDCR after each bus-off recovery, before INIT is cleared.
justifications: The stated workaround restores the transmitter delay compensation offset cleared during bus-off recovery.

concepts.name: HCLK maximum for 2 wait states in VOS1 in MHz
justifications: The errata explicitly corrects the VOS1 HCLK maximum for 2 wait states to 165 MHz, replacing 185 MHz.

concepts.name: Revision C retention after 10 000 cycles at 85 °C
justifications: The product change notification changes revision C flash retention after 10 000 cycles at Ta = 85 °C to 15 years, superseding the datasheet minimum.

concepts.name: Revision C retention after 1 000 cycles at 105 °C
justifications: The datasheet guarantees a minimum retention of 20 years after 1 000 cycles at Ta = 105 °C. The revision C notification leaves this value unchanged.

concepts.name: DR-114 maximum permitted SYSCLK in MHz
justifications: Production devices are revision C, so the VOS1 restriction to 360 MHz does not apply; at the maximum ambient temperature of 95 °C, VOS1 permits 400 MHz. The 1.8 V ±3% supply cannot meet the 1.95 V minimum required for VOS0.

concepts.name: DR-114 PLL1 configuration within specification
justifications: The configured PLL1 reference frequency is 25/5 = 5 MHz, but PLL1RGE = 01 permits only 2–4 MHz. A range selection that does not contain the reference frequency is explicitly outside specification.

concepts.name: DR-114 required flash wait states
justifications: The configured dividers yield SYSCLK = (25/5) × 140/2 = 350 MHz and HCLK = 175 MHz in VOS1. This exceeds the corrected 165 MHz limit for two wait states but falls within the 200 MHz limit for three, making three the minimum permitted.

concepts.name: DR-114 junction temperature in °C
justifications: At 350 MHz, maximum supply current including all clocked peripherals is 134.1 mA, and maximum VDD is 1.854 V. Using the two-internal-plane thermal resistance gives Tj = 95 + 44 × (1.854 × 0.1341 + 0.052) = 108.23 °C, rounded to 108 °C.

concepts.name: DR-114 meets HDR-7
justifications: The fitted TSV7H8LX is grade X, with a 125 °C junction limit, so HDR-7 requires a computed junction temperature no higher than 105 °C. The datasheet-method result of 108.23 °C exceeds that threshold.

concepts.name: Errata applicable to the DR-114 production boards
justifications: The production marking identifies revision C: the ADC operates at 2.4 Msps with VDDA below 2.0 V, and USART1 uses OVER8 = 1 with receiver timeout enabled. FDCAN1 also enables transmitter delay compensation and automatic bus-off recovery, meeting the conditions of ES-08.

concepts.name: DR-114 maximum ADC INL in LSB
justifications: The ADC sampling rate is 36 / (2.5 + 12.5) = 2.4 Msps, and the entire VDDA tolerance range is below 2.0 V. ES-04 therefore specifies a maximum INL magnitude of 6 LSB, and FW 2.3.0 does not implement its workaround.

concepts.name: FW 2.3.0 meets HDR-9 for the DR-114 production boards
justifications: HDR-9 requires workarounds for every applicable erratum; the revision C production configuration meets the conditions of ES-04 and ES-08. FW 2.3.0 implements only ES-02 and ES-05 workarounds, leaving both required workarounds unimplemented.

concepts.context: aspect: DR-115 errata and PLL1 limits
concepts.name: Errata applicable to the DR-115 boards
justifications: The boards use revision B silicon, and their 864 MHz PLL1 VCO configuration and subzero operating environment meet ES-02 conditions. SPI2 operates in TI mode, meeting ES-07 conditions on that revision.

concepts.context: aspect: DR-115 errata and PLL1 limits
concepts.name: DR-115 maximum PLL1 VCO frequency in MHz
justifications: For revision B devices in an application where junction temperature can fall below 0 °C, ES-02 requires PLL1 VCO frequency to remain at or below 836 MHz.

concepts.context: aspect: DR-115 errata and PLL1 limits
concepts.name: DR-115 PLL1 configuration within its limits
justifications: The recorded PLL1 configuration produces (24 / 4) × 144 = 864 MHz. This exceeds the 836 MHz ES-02 workaround limit applicable to revision B boards in their subzero operating environment.

concepts.context: aspect: Revision B end of life
concepts.name: Halyard last-time-buy date for revision B
justifications: The original LTB deadline is 13 September 2026, 90 calendar days after the PCN date. Halyard's forecast registration on 29 July qualifies it for the 30-day extension to 13 October 2026.

concepts.context: aspect: Revision B end of life
concepts.name: Last-shipment date of revision B
justifications: The last-shipment deadline is 180 calendar days after the original LTB deadline of 13 September 2026, yielding 12 March 2027. The amendment explicitly leaves this shipment deadline unchanged.

concepts.context: aspect: Revision B end of life
concepts.name: PO-5521 valid last-time-buy order
justifications: Halyard's timely forecast registration qualifies it for the extended LTB deadline of 13 October 2026. PO-5521 was placed as a revision B LTB order on 2 October 2026, before that deadline.
